name: 综合评分公式与声明/结果范围不闭合
trigger: component bounds and weights imply one score range but grades/final values lie outside it, or adjustment factors break a declared maximum
example: S043 Eq.(5-14) implies <=1 under its component definitions while Table 5.7 reaches 4.620; final fantasy score declares max100 while multiplicative factors can exceed it
gate: derive algebraic min/max before ranking; add explicit transform/clip/renormalization to Result Registry or reject unreplayable score claims
